label: Bible Study
prompt: Therefore they that were _____ abroad went every where preaching the word.
verse: Therefore they that were scattered abroad went every where preaching the word.
note: Persecution scattered the church — and the scattered church preached everywhere it landed.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: So shall thy _____ be filled with plenty, and thy presses shall burst out with new wine.
verse: So shall thy barns be filled with plenty, and thy presses shall burst out with new wine.
note: Honor God with your firstfruits, and your barns fill with plenty and your presses overflow.

label: Sunday School
prompt: Ye are our _____ written in our hearts, known and read of all men:
verse: Ye are our epistle written in our hearts, known and read of all men:
note: Paul tells the Corinthians they are his letter of recommendation — written on hearts, read by everyone.

label: Deep Water
prompt: And when ye reap the harvest of your land, thou shalt not wholly reap the _____ of thy field, neither shalt thou gather the gleanings of thy harvest.
verse: And when ye reap the harvest of your land, thou shalt not wholly reap the corners of thy field, neither shalt thou gather the gleanings of thy harvest.
note: Leave the field's edges for the poor — the very law that let Ruth glean in Boaz's field.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: And the king said, Enquire thou whose son the _____ is.
verse: And the king said, Enquire thou whose son the stripling is.
note: After Goliath fell, Saul asked whose son 'the stripling' was — a lad barely grown, suddenly Israel's hero.
